Keep your glow.

With your permission, this game saves your nickname, your personal best, and the device record in this browser’s local storage. A preference cookie remembers that you accepted. No analytics, advertising cookies, or server leaderboard.

Clearing browser data removes saved scores. Without saving, scores last only until this page closes.

A QUICK GLOW GUIDE

Ready, set, catch.

  1. Move your mouse, drag anywhere in the game, or use the left and right arrow keys.
  2. Catch beauty products for 10 points. Catch five in a row for a 10-point bonus.
  3. A missed product or a caught firework costs one of your three hearts. Let fireworks fall past you.
  4. Every 15 seconds, the pace picks up and the basket gets a little smaller.

Press P to pause, or use the pause button. Switching tabs pauses the game for you.
